name: Composite Structure Diagram
description: Composite Structure Diagram describes the runtime internal structure of a complex classifier or component, including internal parts, ports, and connectors between them.
purpose: Decompose the runtime internal structure of complex design patterns (MVC, Broker) or embedded systems.
bestFor: Describe runtime internal structure of design patterns (MVC, Mediator, Broker)
Design embedded or hardware systems with internal connection ports
Describe how parts inside a component collaborate with each other
notSuitableFor: Describe components from an external view → use Component Diagram
Describe general classes/entities → use Class Diagram
Describe messages over time → use Sequence Diagram

elements.name: Role
elements.description: Role of a part in collaboration

confusableWith.difference: Component views from the outside; Composite Structure decomposes the internal structure of a classifier/component.
Class describes classes and static relationships; Composite Structure describes runtime composition inside a classifier.
